duration_basis: Proposed52-week fixed observation arrangement; not a universal sample sufficiency criterion; optional duration preference requested before observation

cost_scenarios.source: Twofold stress on user-confirmed fee and estimated slippage; not actual charged rate
User-confirmed fee with original estimated slippage and additional15m delay

rule_contract.base_execution: Monday00:15UTC raw opening price plus adverse slippage

account_continuity: One cash10000 account initialized at prospective start per strategy and cost; no old positions; no resets at calendar/weekly boundaries

data_policy.first_seen_limit: Local first-seen proves retrieval time only; late collection does not prove decision-time availability, real-time routing or actual execution

economic_screen.origin: Retain original four diagnostic economic conditions; no promotion gate
all_required: T28 base net_return > vol_scaled_hold base net_return
T28 base max_close_drawdown <= vol_scaled_hold base max_close_drawdown

statistics.origin: New fixed confirmation proposal frozen before future observations; not original industry/promotion standard
statistics.method: Joint noncircular moving-block bootstrap of complete shared UTC week log-equity growth and paired benchmark growth differences
co_primary: mean T28 weekly log equity growth
mean paired T28 minus vol_scaled_hold weekly log equity growth
statistics.adjustment: Bonferroni2co-primary one-sided97.5% lower bounds; both must exceed0
statistics.insufficient: Cannot form two8-week blocks, confidence bound crosses0, or dependence uncertainty remains; retain INCONCLUSIVE
statistics.partial_weeks: Excluded from weekly inference only; all account PnL remains included

eth_dependence.symbol_contribution: realized gross minus actual fees plus signed funding plus marked unrealized; yearly boundary differences of same continuous account
eth_dependence.interpretation: No arbitrary70%/80% cutoff; report exact shares. If total profit positive and BTC contribution<=0, profitability relies on ETH offsetting other contribution. Same-path removal is accounting diagnosis, not independently tradable BTC-only replay.

decision.concentration: Report separately; no global diversification guarantee

operating_plan.collection: Daily completed-UTC-day observation; coverage/status only until fixed end
operating_plan.notifications: Stay quiet on unchanged or normal accumulation; report meaningful quality failure, protocol drift, required user action or final completion; never report interim profitability
operating_plan.terminal_evaluation: Only after fixed end and full verified data; no optional stopping based on profit
